params.name: client_id
params.description: Identifier of the Zeplin app requesting user authentication

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: User is redirected to this endpoint after authorization

params.name: state
params.description: RECOMMENDED. An opaque value used by the client to maintain state between the request and callback.

params.name: code_challenge
params.description: RECOMMENDED. A PKCE code challenge derived from the code verifier, to be verified against later.

params.name: code_challenge_method
params.description: RECOMMENDED. PKCE code verifier transformation method.

items.docs: Users are redirected to web app to authenticate themselves and authorize the app with `client_id` to act on behalf of themselves.
If `grant_type` is given as `authorization_code`; handles code flow. If `grant_type` is given as `refresh_token` handles refresh token flow.
